abstract: A novel in vitro model was developed to study attachment and invasion of choriocarcinoma cell spheroids using pre-cultured secretory phase human endometrium as a host tissue. During pre-culturing in shaker culture human endometrium had regenerated a complete epithelial covering and had shed cells damaged during explantation. Spheroids of three human choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, Jeg-3, JAr) which displayed linear growth in culture and produced placental hormones were used in this study as models for trophoblast behaviour. Morphological differences were noted in the spheroids from the three choriocarcinoma cell lines; BeWo and Jeg-3 spheroids exposed flattened and more differentiated cells on their surfaces while superficial cells in JAr spheroids maintained their cytotrophoblast-like morphology. Spheroids from all three cell lines were proven to be invasive in a general invasion assay using embryonic chick heart fragments, with JAr spheroids being the most aggressive. When spheroids were confronted with pre-cultured re-epithelialized endometrial fragments, however, Jeg-3 spheroids showed the highest incidence of attachment (52%) and the greatest amount of invasion into the underlying stroma. BeWo spheroids also attached (37%) and penetrated the epithelium, but did not invade into the stroma. JAr spheroids showed a minor degree of attachment (12%) and little or no invasion into the stroma. These results show that the three choriocarcinoma cell lines, although all invasive in a general invasion assay, differ in adhesion to uterine epithelium and invasion into endometrial stroma. This model offers opportunities for studying mechanisms of trophoblast adhesion and invasion, using human endometrium as the natural host tissue.
abstract_ja: 新たなin vitroモデルを開発し、絨毛癌細胞スフェロイドの接着と浸潤を検討した。宿主組織としては、あらかじめ培養した分泌期ヒト子宮内膜を用いた。振盪培養中に子宮内膜は完全な上皮被覆を再生し、採取時に障害された細胞は脱落していた。モデルの栄養膜様細胞として、直線的に増殖し胎盤ホルモンを産生するヒト絨毛癌細胞株3種（BeWo、Jeg-3、JAr）のスフェロイドを用いた。スフェロイド表層の形態は株により異なり、BeWoとJeg-3の表面では扁平で分化した細胞が認められた一方、JArのスフェロイド表層細胞は細胞栄養膜様の形態を保っていた。3株のスフェロイドはいずれも、胚発生期のニワトリ心臓片を用いた一般的な浸潤試験で浸潤性を示し、JArが最も攻撃的であった。再上皮化した子宮内膜片との対峙では、Jeg-3スフェロイドが最も高い接着率（52%）を示し、基底の間質へ最も強く浸潤した。BeWoスフェロイドも接着（37%）し上皮を貫通したが、間質への浸潤はなかった。JArスフェロイドの接着はわずか（12%）で、間質への浸潤はほとんど、あるいは全くみられなかった。これらの結果から、3種の絨毛癌細胞株はいずれも一般的な浸潤試験では浸潤性を示すが、子宮上皮への接着と子宮内膜間質への浸潤には違いがあることがわかった。本モデルは、天然の宿主組織であるヒト子宮内膜を用いて、栄養膜の接着と浸潤の機序を検討する機会を提供する。
